capabilities.repo.write: Create/edit repository files within assigned scope
capabilities.web.search: Search/read public web information when needed
capabilities.context.isolate: Execute work in a fresh context independent of implementer context
capabilities.agent.delegate: Delegate a role/task to another isolated worker
capabilities.skills.consume: Discover and activate canonical Agent Skills
capabilities.mcp.client: Connect to approved MCP servers or equivalent tool bridges
capabilities.roblox.studio: Inspect/mutate/test Roblox Studio through approved bridge
capabilities.image.generate: Generate/edit images when asset work requires it
capabilities.image.inspect: Inspect actual image pixels/screenshots/reference frames; not satisfied by filenames, text summaries or generated placeholders
capabilities.decision.ask: Pause affected work and request a material human decision with options/recommendation
capabilities.memory.curate: Read/write compact durable task/project memory artifacts and handoff capsules
capabilities.design.visual: Use an actual visual-design workspace/image inspection/generation capability when available
capabilities.blender.author: Create or modify Blender assets through an approved local Blender tool/MCP profile
capabilities.vfx.author: Create/tune game VFX through approved Roblox/authoring tools
capabilities.audio.author: Create/edit/integrate game audio through approved local/source tools
capabilities.repo.graph: Query/update approved local Graphify project graph for repository topology/impact intelligence; canonical repo/Git/task state remains authoritative
capabilities.world.plan: Produce/review deterministic world/layout plans through an approved generator such as the pinned BloxMaps adapter.
capabilities.ui.blueprint: Produce/review declarative UI blueprints/prototypes through an approved runtime-neutral UI accelerator; not a mandatory frontend framework.
